page.overview:
Who is White Deer Spirit?

The is a demon who became the father-in-law of the king of Bhikṣu Kingdom. He turned out to be the belonging to the Old Man of the South Pole.

In its true form, the White Deer Spirit is striped and has seven jagged horns.

The White Deer was the mount of the Old Man of the South Pole, but while the Old Man was in the middle of a chess game with Chong'en the deer ran off.

The White Deer Spirit had his adopted daughter the White-Faced Vixen Spirit pose as a beautiful woman and married her to the king of the Bhikṣu Kingdom. When the king fell ill and none of his physicians could cure him, the White Deer claimed to be able to make him live for a thousand more years if he drank a stew made from the hearts of 1,100 children.
